name: @sapientpro/json-stream
description: Incremental JSON and JSON5 parser with selective value callbacks and streaming strings

scripts.prepare: npm run build && npm run test
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig-esm.json && node scripts/dist-type.mjs
scripts.benchmark:competitors: npm run build && node scripts/competitors.mjs --engine node --checks && bun scripts/competitors.mjs --engine bun --checks && node scripts/competitors.mjs --engine node && bun scripts/competitors.mjs --engine bun && node scripts/competitors-report.mjs
scripts.benchmark:competitors:node: npm run build && node scripts/competitors.mjs --engine node
scripts.benchmark:competitors:bun: npm run build && bun scripts/competitors.mjs --engine bun
scripts.benchmark:node: npm run build && node scripts/benchmark.mjs --engine node
scripts.benchmark:bun: npm run build && node scripts/benchmark.mjs --engine bun
scripts.benchmark:competitors:deno: npm run build && node scripts/competitors.mjs --engine deno --checks && node scripts/competitors.mjs --engine deno --secondary && node scripts/competitors-report.mjs --engines node,bun,deno
scripts.build:legacy: tsc -p legacy/v2/tsconfig.json && tsc -p legacy/v2/tsconfig-esm.json && node scripts/dist-type.mjs legacy/v2/dist
scripts.benchmark:legacy: npm run build:legacy && node --expose-gc legacy/v2/scripts/benchmark.mjs && bun legacy/v2/scripts/benchmark.mjs && node legacy/v2/scripts/benchmark-report.mjs
